conclusion: The 10k one-model merge is caused by the port's non-faithful EstimateTriangulation producing cross-boundary points COLMAP does not. Graph, triangulator Options, candidate gates, visible-point bookkeeping and split logic are all identical. Next: port COLMAP's TriangulateTrack/EstimateTriangulation (LORANSAC + CombinationSampler + TriangulationEstimator semantics) faithfully, gate on 2.5k non-regression, then 10k.
method: Extracted, from the port's existing 10k model (tier-10000-ceres-gauge6-v1/model/model/0), the points whose track spans frames <=4493 and >=4495, and compared with COLMAP's model0 (0 such points). No rerun.

triangulator_deviation.colmap: Create -> TriangulateTrack -> EstimateTriangulation = LORANSAC over TriangulationEstimator with a CombinationSampler (exhaustive pair combinations for <=15 views) and iterative local optimization (estimators/triangulation.cc).
triangulator_deviation.effect: The port turns weak cross-boundary correspondences into long tracks (via create/continue/complete) that COLMAP's model0 never forms, so image 9497 reaches >=8 visible points and frame 4497 registers inside model 0, merging the two components that COLMAP keeps separate.
triangulator_deviation.port: estimate_triangulation = deterministic best-pair by inlier count over an evenly-strided, <=40-correspondence hypothesis subset, with a single refit; documented in incremental_triangulator.rs as a non-faithful replacement (no LORANSAC/CombinationSampler).
